source: &505 The panel bears the two-barred emblem of Centralized Government. Beneath this, a warning to unauthorized users or those not from the Utilities Office.
target: &505 面板上印着中枢政府的双横杠徽记。下面是警告，禁止未经授权或不属于公用设施部门的人员使用。

source: &551 It's old and rusty, but still locked.
target: &551 虽然又旧又锈，可还是锁着。

source: &693 A steel grate, as rusted as everything else down here.
target: &693 一块钢格栅，跟这里其他东西一样锈迹斑斑。

source: &694 Looks like it covers the access to another shaft.
target: &694 看来，盖着通往另一条竖井的入口。

source: &695 I'm not strong enough to open it with my bare hands.
target: &695 我力气不够，没法徒手打开。

source: &696 This tunnel is small, but could still fit someone on all-fours.
target: &696 隧道很小，不过一个人应该还能爬进去。

source: &697 I wonder if it serves as access to the other systems down here.
target: &697 不知道，能不能从这里进入下面其他设施。

source: &698 This utility panel controls the flow of resources to buildings in this neighborhood.
target: &698 这块设施面板，控制着向附近楼宇供应的资源。

source: &510 INVALID USER[[Warning: Unauthorized use of CITY OF NEWTON utilities terminals carries a penalty of fine, imprisonment or reconditioning.
target: &510 无效用户[[警告：未经授权使用牛顿市公用设施终端，可处以罚款、监禁或行为矫正。

source: &511 Having already breached this system's primitive defences, you decide not to waste any more wetware.
target: &511 你已经攻破了这个系统简陋的防御，决定不再浪费湿件。

source: &699 The way back on to the street. At least it's not daylight out there.
target: &699 回到街上的路。至少，外面还没天亮。
